integrated_multimodal_description: Claymation plasticine stop-motion, handcrafted modelling clay with visible fingerprints and matte finish, photographed on a miniature practical set. A tiled aisle inside the bus terminal runs past a bolted bench with a bus silhouette cast into its back. At the drivers' cold counter, a plain cross marks a dry handover hatch just left of center. A short indoor passage leads to its sill. A handspan-wide steel chill plate is bolted flat into the worktop beside a dry ledge. Its upward purge port sits in a low round seat stamped from the same subzero steel as the rim. A finger's width of shallow steel separates the seat from a thick rim of old white frost. Warm strip light fills the hatch; cool side light grazes the plate and picks out the lip of the seat in profile. TEO (frame left): tall thin white clay man, huge straw-blond walrus moustache, teal knitted beanie with cream stripes, red-and-black checked flannel shirt, brown suspenders, khaki trousers, dark boots. JUCA (frame right): short wide Black clay man, burnt-brown flat cap, mustard cable-knit sweater, olive-green trousers, pale wooden clogs, pencil behind the right ear. Exactly two clay puppets appear in the frame: TEO stays at frame left and JUCA stays at frame right; no other people or animals appear. AT START: TEO is left with the job card in his left hand; JUCA is right with his hands clear. The wet sponge disc projects above the ring gauge with one bead on top. The steel between the ring and the frosted rim is dry; the hatch is empty. [Shot 1] Front wide. TEO bends both knees and sweeps his free forearm level with the metal ring. JUCA steps forward on the right and brings his right palm down toward the high sponge. [Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the camera cuts to Medium at plate height. TEO rocks back on his heels and lowers his forearm to mark the height of the steel lip. JUCA folds his front knee and presses his right palm against the wet disc. At contact the sponge flattens down to the lip. Water squeezed from its sides spills over that lip in one broad sheet onto the dry steel. [Shot 3] At 00:06.800, the camera cuts to Widen on the same axis. JUCA lifts his right palm and straightens; the sponge springs back inside the ring. TEO goes down on one knee and marks the new height with his free forearm. As the sponge rises, the film left by the squeeze glints in one unbroken line from its top down the near side, over the gauge lip into the same puddle. The puddle spreads the last finger's width to the frosted rim. They do not speak and their mouths do not move, but they breathe, swallow and react with their whole bodies. AT END: TEO is down on one knee on the left with the job card in his left hand; JUCA is upright on the right with hands clear. The wet sponge disc has sprung back inside the ring gauge. One shallow puddle covers the plate from the ring to the frosted rim. A thin wet film extends from the sponge top down its side and over the gauge lip into that same puddle. The hatch is empty.
overall_soundscape: Rubber soles squeak on tile as JUCA widens his stance; wet cellulose squelches once under his palm; water splashes low against steel at the foot of the ring; JUCA gives a short nasal huff as he straightens; water laps softly against the frosted lip.
non_diegetic_music: Quiet viola pizzicato leans on one low beat and lifts through a short triplet.
